name: runkeys
description: Registry run keys: install, remove, and list the Run key seat under HKCU or HKLM -- persist.runkeys's execution half packed as the artifact an implant loads through module.load.

opsec.notes: Server side, the package lands as descriptor rows and one artifact file under the module store -- no code runs in the teamserver. On the target, the implant half loads from staged task content, mapped in memory on Windows -- nothing on disk itself. The seat is one registry value: its command line sits in the hive as plain text any blue-team reader sees, and it runs at every interactive logon while it sits. HKCU seats need no elevation; HKLM seats need an elevated implant.
